policy.runtime_materialization: Only source-specific, reader-ready rows on existing canonical entities may enter runtime; identity-firewall, category/formula/product, route-specific, retracted, unresolved-entity and under-extracted receipts remain research-only.
policy.validation_strategy: 200 findings authored before consolidated admission/runtime/repository verification

waves.focus: Six-week randomized placebo-controlled Crocus sativus stigma-extract trial in mild-to-moderate depression; preserve extract identity, short duration, and diagnosis boundary.
Small double-blind GAD trial versus oxazepam; comparable symptom improvement with slower onset in the trial, but small sample and comparator design prevent broad equivalence claims.
Standardized SHR-5 randomized trial in stress-related fatigue; preserve extract identity and fatigue-context boundary.
2025 12-week randomized trial in 101 healthy adults testing Bacumen for cognition, stress and fatigue; proprietary extract and healthy-population limits retained.
Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in 90 Korean volunteers with mild cognitive impairment; MCI-specific cognition evidence, not healthy nootropic evidence.
Four-week randomized crossover trial in healthy adults; selected stress-related and cognitive outcomes, with isolated-theanine and chronic-exposure boundaries.
2025 randomized placebo-controlled trial in 155 adults with self-reported poor sleep; magnesium-bisglycinate/formulation-specific sleep evidence.
Four-week randomized trial of fast-release melatonin in middle-aged adults with primary insomnia; formulation, age, duration and insomnia-diagnosis boundaries retained.
10-week randomized trial in 539 adults with GAD comparing Silexan doses, placebo and paroxetine; Silexan-specific oral lavender evidence.
Randomized placebo-controlled Matricaria recutita extract trial in mild-to-moderate GAD; preliminary diagnosis- and extract-specific evidence.
Eight-week randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in major depressive disorder; curcumin regimen and psychiatric-population boundaries retained.
Large randomized trial in major depressive episodes; overall primary analysis only trended toward benefit while a prespecified non-anxious subgroup improved, so no uniform antidepressant claim.
Eight-week randomized trial of creatine augmentation of escitalopram in women with MDD; adjunctive, sex-specific psychiatric evidence.
Small randomized crossover pilot in older adults with chronic insomnia; some subjective benefits but several objective sleep outcomes did not differ from placebo.
Randomized double-blind crossover study in healthy adults during sustained mental effort; acute mood/cognition effects with healthy-population and short-term boundaries.
16-week randomized trial in mild cognitive impairment; combination-only evidence with subgroup-limited memory/attention signals and no attribution to either ingredient alone.
2012 randomized-trial review; lower UTI risk in women with recurrent UTIs with substantial heterogeneity; prevention not active-infection treatment.
16-trial review of inorganic nitrate/beetroot juice; systolic-BP signal, diastolic null, short heterogeneous interventions and dose-response meta-regression kept together.
Earlier glycemic meta-analysis; glucose reductions concentrated in medium/high-dose diabetes trials with substantial heterogeneity; dose and disease status remain explicit.
17-trial BP meta-analysis; modest SBP/DBP reductions overall but systolic benefit concentrated in hypertensive rather than normotensive participants.
Clinical-trial meta-analysis finding reduced UTI incidence versus controls; prevention-only evidence with product heterogeneity.
Small meta-analysis of 180 participants reporting reduced upper-respiratory symptom severity; limited evidence base and no specific influenza-treatment claim.
2019 review showing possible lower URI risk but no convincing shortening of illness duration; varied preparations and selective-reporting concerns retained.
Umbrella meta-analysis documenting conflicting glycemic conclusions across prior cinnamon syntheses; explicit counterweight to a single efficacy label.
24-RCT T2D dose-response meta-analysis; fasting glucose/HbA1c signals with insulin null and substantial preparation/trial heterogeneity.
Eight-RCT anxiety meta-analysis (567 participants); pooled symptom signal with very high heterogeneity, so direction and certainty remain separate.
2025 nine-RCT cognition meta-analysis (501 participants); global-cognition signal concentrated in longer studies and adults 60+, making duration and age explicit modifiers.
2025 GRADE synthesis of 82 RCTs/5,026 participants; cardiometabolic biomarker signals across widely varying forms, doses and durations; surrogate-outcome boundary retained.
2025 pediatric systematic review of 15 trials; no significant pooled side-effect increase but limited pediatric evidence and no established pediatric dose/formulation inference.
2025 GRADE meta-analysis of 29 RCTs; CRP/TNF-alpha/IL-6 and oxidative-stress biomarker improvements, not direct proof of disease prevention or treatment.
2025 36-RCT GRADE review; waist/body-fat and adiponectin signals while body weight/BMI were null—explicit counterweight to broad weight-loss claims.
2026 inflammation meta-analysis; overall CRP and IL-6 null with high heterogeneity plus subgroup increases in CRP/IL-6 in selected populations/formulations.
2025 network meta-analysis of 18 RCTs/2,177 breast-cancer patients; silymarin signal for grade >=2 radiation dermatitis but no superiority for severe grade >=3 dermatitis.
2026 ten-study synthesis; BMI signal with body-weight/waist nulls and overall liver-enzyme nulls, including subgroup AST increase requiring caution.
2026 50-RCT systematic review; glycemic effects more consistent than body-weight/BMI effects, with substantial heterogeneity across seed powder, seed extract and leaf extract.
2025 vascular and GRADE syntheses; FMD/NO/PWV and selected inflammatory/adiponectin signals, augmentation-index and anthropometric nulls retained.
2025 oral/mucosal-health systematic review; mucositis/pain/inflammation signals with antimicrobial and gingival-index nulls and limited trial counts.
2025 14-RCT meta-analysis in postmenopausal women; BP, antioxidant-capacity and vasomotor findings remain population-specific.
2025 cognition synthesis; global cognition null despite working-memory/processing-speed subgroup signals, plus higher adverse-event incidence versus controls.
Sleep systematic review of five trials/379 participants; preliminary duration/quality signals with a small evidence base.
2026 T2D-specific body-composition review; weight/BMI/waist evidence stays diabetes-population specific pending exact quantitative extraction.
2026 34-RCT dose-response meta-analysis in prediabetes/T2D; glucose/HbA1c/insulin/HOMA-IR signals with HOMA-B null and formulation/health-status modifiers.
2026 umbrella review of 36 publications/296 trials/43,570 participants; CRP/IL-6 and oxidative-stress consistency is biomarker-level, not clinical-outcome proof.
2026 exercise meta-analysis of 13 RCTs/599 participants; objective performance evidence concentrated in young/athletic populations.
38-RCT BP meta-analysis/2,709 participants; modest SBP/DBP reductions with stronger hypertensive/hypomagnesemic subgroup signals, normotensive null and no clear dose-response.
Placebo-controlled metabolic-syndrome meta-analysis; TG/FPG/waist/LDL/TC signals with HDL and BP nulls, short-duration differences and no excess pooled safety signal.
2026 scoping review of 57 reviews/227 meta-analyses; most inactive-comparator syntheses favored melatonin but methodology quality and sleep-outcome definitions were highly variable.
2026 psychiatric systematic review; five RCTs, all adjunctive and short term, with one strong MDD augmentation signal, other null trials, and hypomania/mania safety events in a small subset.
2026 Cochrane review of 82 studies/10,613 participants; small low-certainty dementia signals, little/no effect in MCI, and overall adverse-event rates near placebo.
2026 18-RCT cognition review spanning curcumin/turmeric/ginger; memory signal but executive/global/attention nulls and very uncertain heterogeneous evidence; category-level only.
2026 umbrella review of 33 SR/MAs across 111 metabolic indicators; category-level evidence only, with no inheritance to an individual polysaccharide.
14 RCTs/1,227 men across mixed herbal products; product-specific signals coexist with insufficient evidence for some botanicals, so no category-wide efficacy claim.
Cross-sectional safety/interaction map across 19 countries and 49 herbs in T2D; contextual safety evidence, not efficacy and not uniform risk across herbs.
18 studies/1,984 participants of herbal/natural products with PPI therapy for H. pylori; combination-context evidence with nonstandard outcomes and exploratory microbiome findings.
163 studies/15,757 participants; network meta-analysis with high heterogeneity and author-flagged implausible effects; sensitivity/disagreement must stay visible.
270 studies/26,053 participants; adjunct-to-antipsychotic evidence only and low certainty, not monotherapy efficacy.
111-study observational synthesis; no clear overall major adverse-outcome signal after adjustment but herb-specific signals, confounding and evidence quality require separation.
82 meta-analyses/1,263 RCTs; no universal decoction-versus-capsule/granule effect-size rule; formulation claims require intervention-specific evidence.
29 trials/2,000 participants across supplements in MCI/AD; multi-node network evidence must remain intervention- and endpoint-specific.
50 RCTs/2,042 participants; microbiome and short-chain-fatty-acid findings are associative/mechanistic and not proof of clinical prebiotic benefit.
Dietary-supplement evidence in endometriosis is intervention- and outcome-specific; no category-level therapeutic claim.
Endurance RCT meta-analysis; athletic context and biomarker-versus-performance endpoints remain separate.
Randomized-trial meta-analysis reported anxiety/depression score improvements without serious adverse effects; acute-setting emphasis and heterogeneity retained.
16 randomized placebo-controlled studies/1,093 participants; sleep-quality benefit appeared in a subset but methodological issues, preparation variability and publication bias limit certainty.
21 controlled studies/1,717 participants; total/LDL cholesterol reductions with dose/time relationships; historical limitations and dietary-adjunct context retained.
Cochrane acute-respiratory evidence suggested possible symptom benefit in acute bronchitis; product identity and study quality remain explicit.
Osteoarthritis clinical evidence suggests possible pain/function benefit but trials are small and extract/duration specific.
Systematic review of osteoarthritis/low-back pain; possible pain reduction with preparation and trial-quality limitations.
2026 node-resolved review of 49 controlled reports across 20 Ayurvedic dravya nodes; botanical node, plant material and identity certainty must remain separate.
Network meta-analysis of 186 RCTs/13 interventions; heterogeneous formulations and network rankings cannot be treated as head-to-head proof.
Meta-analysis in older adults with cognitive impairment evaluating sleep/cognitive outcomes; age and cognitive-status population boundary retained.
2026 review of human herbal trials in Alzheimer/dementia; herb-specific efficacy and safety must not be collapsed into a single herbal-medicine claim.
31 clinical-trial articles/3,582 participants across natural compounds in AD/MCI; effects varied by compound, endpoint and duration.
Umbrella review found most underlying herbal dementia reviews critically low or weak quality; evidence-quality counterweight to positive signals.
Systematic toxicology review of toxic phytoconstituents/mechanisms; safety-layer evidence only, not efficacy.
Salvia officinalis extract in 60 euglycemic women with PCOS for 8 weeks; HOMA-IR/insulin/QUICKI/BMI signals with WHR/SBP nulls; PCOS/formulation specific.
Standardized Zembrin safety/tolerability study in 37 healthy adults over 3 months; no efficacy variables, so safety-only evidence.
Proprietary Zembrin crossover study in 21 healthy adults over 3 weeks; selected cognitive/executive signals with small-sample/product boundary.
Single-dose Zembrin study in 20 healthy volunteers; one anxiety experiment null with selected subjective/heart-rate interaction signals; acute small-sample evidence.
12-week DB-RCT in overweight/obesity; DXA total-fat-mass signal but body-fat-percent coprimary null; retrospective registration and preliminary status preserved.
Exact-species older trial in prediabetes/hyperlipidemia using leaf/root-bark preparation; species/preparation firewall retained.
Exact-species T2D crossover study using extract biscuit; food-matrix/formulation and diabetes-population boundary retained.
Kothala Himbutu tea trial in T2D; exact-species beverage preparation retained separately from extracts.
Open-label obesity evidence for Salacia plus vitamin D3; combination-only and nonblinded, so no single-ingredient attribution.
Patented multi-ingredient menopausal VMS product RCT; hot-flash/HFRDIS signals, MENQOL/PSQI nulls, product-level only with sponsor/conflict provenance.
Source-integrity correction: PMID 20386132 is a citrulline-malate trial, not taurine; preserve as an anti-contamination receipt.
Retracted aged-garlic meta-analysis; retain only as quarantine metadata and never aggregate into active efficacy evidence.
Curcumin-piperine evidence is formulation-specific; piperine-containing products must not be generalized to curcumin alone.
T2D nanocurcumin evidence; nanoformulation and diabetes population remain explicit and non-interchangeable with generic curcumin.
Herbal network meta-analysis in MASLD/MASH focused on liver enzymes/stiffness; multi-intervention disease-specific evidence only.
72 RCTs/6,351 participants in sepsis; injectable route is fundamental and must not be inherited by oral botanical products.
Eleven-botanical adjunctive HFrEF formulation; product/composition and adjunct-to-standard-care boundaries retained.
Formula evidence in neuropathy-prevention context; multi-herb formulation and indication-specific boundary retained.
Scoping review of 47 studies/2,568 participants; traditional multi-herb formula evidence remains product/formula specific.
Review of 96 formula RCTs documenting harms-reporting deficiencies; evidence-quality/safety infrastructure, not proof of safety.
26-RCT active-control AE meta-analysis with lower reported AE risk; comparator/formulation-specific and not proof of intrinsic herbal safety.
Herbal-interaction evidence in radiation oncology; treatment-context safety layer only.
Emerging supplement/cosmetic allergen evidence; safety/identity layer only, with exposure route and product composition preserved.
12-week skin-aging RCT using Agastache alone versus Agastache/Ficus/Lycium combination; industry provenance and arm identity retained.
Khapregesic-specific menopausal-symptom RCT; preparation-specific product evidence with no generic Khaya inheritance.
